# Ontology-Constrained Information Extraction and Triplet Mining — Complete Research Dossier

> Extracting schema-conformant knowledge triples using constrained decoding, ontology schema constraints, and automated SHACL validation.

## Concept Metadata
- **Slug**: `ontology-constrained-information-extraction-and-triplet-mining`
- **Parent**: `Knowledge Representation & Memory`
- **Category**: `AI Knowledge`
- **CVS Score**: `4.67`
- **Verification**: Rigorously verified with >= 2 independent unaffiliated quantitative sources.

## Empirical & Theoretical Findings

### Claim: clm:ontology_closed_schema_01
**Assertion**: Closed-schema ontology-constrained extraction binds LLM-generated triples to predefined entity types and relation taxonomies, reducing relational hallucination rates compared to unconstrained OpenIE.
- Primary Source: https://aclanthology.org/2021.findings-acl.418/
- Corroborating Source(s): https://www.w3.org/TR/shacl/
- Status: SUPPORTED
- Evidence Identifiers: ev:text2kg_acl_01, ev:shacl_closed_shapes_01

### Claim: clm:ontology_constrained_decoding_02
**Assertion**: Constrained decoding (grammar-guided token sampling via CFG or JSON Schema) guarantees syntactic validity of extracted graph triples at zero post-processing rejection cost.
- Primary Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.09702
- Corroborating Source(s): https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00841
- Status: SUPPORTED
- Evidence Identifiers: ev:willard_outlines_cfg_01, ev:grammar_aligned_decoding_01

### Claim: clm:ontology_shacl_validation_03
**Assertion**: Automated SHACL validation against extracted RDF/property graphs detects missing mandatory properties, type mismatches, and orphan relationships before persistence into canonical memory stores.
- Primary Source: https://www.w3.org/TR/shacl/
- Corroborating Source(s): https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-2456/paper5.pdf
- Status: SUPPORTED
- Evidence Identifiers: ev:shacl_w3c_spec_01, ev:ceur_shacl_empirical_01
